close.notApplicable: the node starts no session, so no child process of its own outlives it

intake.notApplicable: intake starts no session and no child process

merge.notApplicable: the node starts no session, so no child process of its own outlives it

netwatch.notApplicable: netwatch starts no session; its GitHub calls are synchronous and end inside the tick, so no child of its own outlives it

restart.notApplicable: the node starts no session, so no child process of its own outlives it

supervisor.notApplicable: StalledSessions starts no process; a session it ends it ends by name, which Z7 judges, not a child left behind

update.notApplicable: the node starts no session, so no child process of its own outlives it

window.notApplicable: miko:watch starts no session and no child process; it reads the bus and writes its own cursor

Z1.text: a process that leaves does not kill its children

answer.notApplicable: the owner's moves run as window requests the bus answers (scripts/window/window-requests.ts); this node holds no timer or condition an owner move passes

close.notApplicable: the owner's moves run as window requests the bus answers (scripts/window/window-requests.ts); this node holds no timer or condition an owner move passes

intake.notApplicable: intake admits and widens cards and moves none on the owner's word

merge.notApplicable: the owner's moves run as window requests the bus answers (scripts/window/window-requests.ts); this node holds no timer or condition an owner move passes

netwatch.notApplicable: netwatch moves no card; it records what GitHub shows

restart.notApplicable: the owner's moves run as window requests the bus answers (scripts/window/window-requests.ts); this node holds no timer or condition an owner move passes

review.notApplicable: the owner's moves run as window requests the bus answers (scripts/window/window-requests.ts); this node holds no timer or condition an owner move passes

supervisor.notApplicable: StalledSessions ends or requeues a stalled session by its stall lines and moves no card on the owner's word

update.notApplicable: the owner's moves run as window requests the bus answers (scripts/window/window-requests.ts); this node holds no timer or condition an owner move passes

window.notApplicable: miko:watch moves no card; the owner's moves are window requests scripts/window/window-requests.ts answers, witnessed by scripts/tests/window/owner-moves-a-card.test.ts

witness.notApplicable: the owner's moves run as window requests the bus answers (scripts/window/window-requests.ts); this node holds no timer or condition an owner move passes

Z10.text: the owner's word moves any card past every timer and automatic condition — stop its live session, launch it now, give it to the window now, queue its task again without a board alarm — each an owner command given through the owner channel and recorded as one bus event naming the owner, refused only when the move is physically impossible, with that cause named

close.notApplicable: the node starts no session, runs no test and judges no CI run, so no timeout under load, abandoned run or usage limit reaches it as its own failure

intake.notApplicable: intake admits from the card text and the bus; it starts no session, runs no test and reads no CI run

merge.notApplicable: the merge node merges only on a green CI and starts no session; an abandoned run reaches it as not green, and its rerun belongs to netwatch and the update node

restart.notApplicable: the node starts no session, runs no test and judges no CI run, so no timeout under load, abandoned run or usage limit reaches it as its own failure

Z2.text: an infrastructure failure (a timeout under load, an abandoned CI run, a usage limit, a failed measurement) is a retry, not a defect and not a question for the owner

netwatch.notApplicable: netwatch records what GitHub shows as bus events and takes no decision a window decision governs

supervisor.notApplicable: StalledSessions applies the stall lines it is built with and takes no decision a window decision governs

window.notApplicable: the window is where these decisions are taken; the law is about the nodes that act on them

Z3.text: decisions of the window under a shard act the same in every node

netwatch.notApplicable: netwatch opens no wait: a retry-after is a netwatch.skipped event carrying its until, and the clock lifts it

supervisor.notApplicable: StalledSessions opens no wait: it raises session.stalled, queues a dead session's task again or ends a review session

Z4.text: every "waits" has a wait record and the one who lifts it

intake.notApplicable: intake launches nothing; it admits a card the launch node later starts

window.notApplicable: miko:watch launches nothing; a card the window starts is launched by the launch node, which writes the event

Z5.text: every launch writes its own event

intake.notApplicable: intake writes the parking lane and the bus, never a card tree

netwatch.notApplicable: netwatch writes no tree, only bus events and its heartbeat

supervisor.notApplicable: StalledSessions writes bus events and task releases, never a card tree

window.notApplicable: miko:watch writes no card tree, only its cursor beside the handoff

Z6.text: a dirty tree has a way back

close.notApplicable: the node starts no session, so the factory reading holds no beat of its own to weigh

intake.notApplicable: intake reads no liveness: it admits from the card text, the decisions in force and the bus card states

merge.notApplicable: the node starts no session, so the factory reading holds no beat of its own to weigh

restart.notApplicable: the node starts no session, so the factory reading holds no beat of its own to weigh

update.notApplicable: the node starts no session, so the factory reading holds no beat of its own to weigh

intake.notApplicable: intake continues no card session; it is where a card stopped outside its touches goes to have them widened

netwatch.notApplicable: netwatch continues no card session; it records what GitHub shows

review.notApplicable: the node continues no session of a card, so no stop of one decides a continuation here

supervisor.notApplicable: StalledSessions continues no card session; it ends or requeues a stalled one and reads no stop reason

update.notApplicable: the node continues no session of a card, so no stop of one decides a continuation here

window.notApplicable: miko:watch continues no card session; the launch and answer nodes decide a continuation from the stop they record

witness.notApplicable: the node continues no session of a card, so no stop of one decides a continuation here
